why_N20.text: N=9 satisfies the frozen precision gate (CI half-width <= 0.5 at rho=1) but resolves an EXPLAINED verdict with only ~53% probability at the scientifically central case rho=1. N=20 is the frozen protocol cap, is not a new quantity, and raises that probability to ~93% (approximate, historical-variance based). The choice is made before the first launch of any end-to-end campaign.

unchanged_frozen_elements: Fieller 95% CI for rho with t quantile, df = blocks-1
ABBA block estimator (mean of per-block contrasts)
workload r2-11-coding-v1, seed 42, greedy, 512 tokens, ctx 4096
timing_observation_disclosure: No end-to-end timing campaign data exist. The four conformance launches were traced correctness runs (per-token decode 477-524 ms; ~126 ms untraced historically) and their timing fields are not evidence and were not used for this decision. N=20 was fixed by the researcher from the precision/power rationale above, which uses only the microbenchmark freeze and historical R3-02-p4 variance.
